correctness.rationale: Exact companion-matrix identities, four verified odd first coefficients, divisible higher binomial coefficients, factorial Lipschitz bounds and the 2-adic finite-quotient bijectivity proof reconstruct all three output classes for every modulus. The trace-doubling identity covers 4-divisible indices. Complete state-cycle tests independently confirm exponents 6 through 15; no experimental extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: For a canonical second-order recurrence, the result upgrades an existing non-completeness theorem to an exact three-coset 2-adic image at all scales, a stable rational density of 9/64, and an explicit structural explanation by index progressions. This is not a finite table recomputation or arbitrary isolated small-modulus invariant.
